patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action moves toward the speaker. こん is a short old-man form of こない. もどってこん = 'not come back here'.

patterns.name: 〜ないか
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb followed by か, said sharply, is a strong order. こん is the short old-man form of こない. もどってこんか = 'get back here!'
